meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为ADHD读者调整输出格式，突出下一步行动和关键信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的读者容易分心，需要清晰、结构化的信息呈现。
copy.tagline_en: Format output for ADHD readers, highlighting next actions and key info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your readers get distracted easily and need clear, structured information.

howto.what: Claude 会以行动开头，用编号步骤说明多步任务，每次对话重申当前进度，给出具体时间估计，突出已完成成果，避免无关内容。
howto.when: 当你说“/i-have-adhd”时触发，持续生效直到你说“stop adhd mode”。

say.text: 帮我写一个登录功能，用 /i-have-adhd
say.note: Claude 会以具体步骤和行动开头回答。
Claude 会详细解释但保持结构清晰。
关闭该技能，恢复默认回复风格。

howto.what_en: Claude leads with the next action, numbers multi-step tasks, restates progress each turn, gives specific time estimates, highlights completed work, and suppresses tangents.
howto.when_en: Triggered by saying "/i-have-adhd". Stays active until you say "stop adhd mode".

say_en.text: Help me write a login function, using /i-have-adhd
say_en.note: Claude will reply with concrete steps and actions first.
Claude will explain thoroughly but keep structure clear.
Disables the skill, reverts to default style.
